// 02 — The Cohort Model

Why selected builds cost less.

We build selected web applications at no core build cost, or at a reduced rate. The finished product becomes proof of our engineering, while the partner covers only the infrastructure, licences, and third-party services their product uses.

TENET 01

Software as sovereign media

Every system we ship is a permanent, working advertisement. Code doesn't decay like ad spend — it compounds.

TENET 02

Brand capital over short-term revenue

We invest senior engineering in a few partners each cohort. Reputation compounds faster than invoices.

TENET 03

The integration moat

Integrating AI agents into dependable system-level software is hard to copy. Engineering depth is the moat.

STANDARD PROJECT MODEL

Scope, quote, then build.

  • Upfront estimate tied to a defined scope
  • Change requests priced separately
  • Delivery concludes with a formal handover
  • The relationship may end at launch
MATROXX COHORT MODEL

Proof, partnership, then growth.

  • $0 core build for selected projects
  • Project brief followed by a technical call
  • You cover infrastructure and hosting at cost
  • Limited slots keep each build focused
  • Case studies are published only with partner approval

Infrastructure, licences, and third-party API costs always remain with the partner — at cost, never marked up. Cohort selection is competitive.

// 03 — Work

Flagship implementation.

One live product demonstrates the model. Two cohort spaces are open for the next focused builds.

FLAGSHIP 01 · LIVE

SL Tech Radar

Our first product — and proof of the model. A weekly AI research assistant for Sri Lankan tech students: hackathons, internships, free courses, and scholarships, gathered by an AI pipeline and presented through a 3D radar interface.

Spring Boot 4 + Spring AI backend — 31/31 tests passing — with a Next.js 16 frontend. Live in production, running at about $0.0022 a week.
